marta (finance): morning — NetSuite nightly job rejected 14 invoices with "Line amount must be >= 0". All tied to the new pricing experiment (step discount + overflow credit).

josh (eng-billing): any sample invoice we can inspect?

marta (finance): invoice_2026_12_11_300 (sanitized payload below). NetSuite retried and produced a manual credit memo that now doesn't reconcile to Stripe.

anika (revops): that matches the AR variance alert I raised. We should hold outgoing customer notices until we know scope.

billing-bot: webhook_retry: invoice.created invoice_2026_12_11_300 attempts=2 status=400 ns_err="Line amount must be >= 0"

leo (eng-platform): paste the payload so we can check rounding/serialization.

marta (finance): payload (sanitized):
```json
{
  "id": "invoice_2026_12_11_300",
  "customer": "cus_XYZ",
  "lines": [
    {"desc": "usage", "qty": 980, "unit_price": 0.05, "amount": 49.0},
    {"desc": "step discount", "amount": -4.9},
    {"desc": "overflow promo adj", "amount": -44.10000000000001},
    {"desc": "tax", "amount": 0.0}
  ],
  "total": 0.0
}
```

josh (eng-billing): yep — JS float artifact. When we round each line to 2 decimals for NetSuite, combined rounding can push a line to -0.01. NetSuite rejects negative final line amounts.

leo (eng-platform): mitigation plan: add a normalization step in the sync service that 1) formats decimals as fixed-2 strings, 2) clamps tiny negatives (abs(amount) < 0.05) to 0.00 and tags the invoice metadata with "normalized=true". Deploying to staging now.

josh (eng-billing): also adding validation on producer side to emit fixed-2 decimal strings and a "rounded_by":"producer" flag so we can trace origin of any fixes. I'll attach unit tests for step+overflow combos.

anika (revops): CS — please pause any automated memos/notifications for affected accounts. I'll prepare messaging and collect invoice ids.

marta (finance): added affected ids to cs_queue. Finance ops will need to clean up two manual memos already created.

billing-bot: deploy started: sync-normalize-v1 -> staging (sha: b9f8e4)

leo (eng-platform): staging replay of yesterday's failed set shows normalized lines and no rejects. Planning a 5% canary for prod in 2h, full rollout after verification.

marta (finance): 2h notice to CS before full flip please.

josh (eng-billing): noted. I'll attach raw payloads to the ticket for the cleanup work and disable the experiment if more failures surface during backfill.

billing-bot: deploy succeeded: sync-normalize-v1 -> staging (sha: b9f8e4)

leo (eng-platform): canary scheduled. I'll post results here. :eyes:

marta (finance): thanks everyone. Follow-ups: 1) backfill 72h and generate reconciliation report, 2) Finance ops to clean journals, 3) consider permanent rule to never send negative line amounts to NetSuite. :white_check_mark:
